$comment: Machine-readable canonical spec of the 17-state case lifecycle. States map 1:1 to the Case.status enum. Transitions transcribe 03 SS4 exactly; the HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED wildcard row ('* any active state') is kept as to='ANY_ACTIVE' and expands to the 11 other active states at load time.

NEW_CONTACT.timeout_behavior: n/a (synchronous). If contact drops before intake, immediate callback attempt per the WAITING_FOR_CLIENT_INFO policy.
entry_requires: inbound call/WhatsApp/SMS/email/web-form/web-chat with no matching open case, OR manually created case
channel identity (phone/email/handle)
raw first message or call recording
allowed_ai_actions: identify returning client via Deal Memory
escalation_triggers: safety emergency (gas leak: give safety script + emergency route)
NEW_CONTACT.notes: Answering an inbound contact is a distinct action class: L1-L2 capture-and-notify only; conversational answering requires L3+ (MVP default L3 for inbound-answer).

INTAKE_IN_PROGRESS.timeout_behavior: Client silent mid-intake: retry per FollowUpPriority (typically +2h same channel, then +24h alternate channel).
entry_requires: from NEW_CONTACT once intent is a serviceable request
industry playbook selected (IndustryPlaybook)
intake checklist instantiated as MissingItem rows
allowed_ai_actions: ask industry intake questions (name, address, problem type, urgency, scope, timing, budget band, existing competing quote)
INTAKE_IN_PROGRESS.followup_timing: +2h same channel, then +24h alternate channel on silence

QUALIFIED.timeout_behavior: None specified: 'immediate progression; no dwell' (see verification doc issue F: must be transient or get a timeout).
entry_requires: LeadScore >= theta_qualify
core required fields present
fit-to-services C > 0
address/service area, job type, urgency, rough scope, decision-maker signal
allowed_ai_actions: book a survey/visit if playbook allows (L4)
prepare DecisionBrief stub for the owner

WAITING_FOR_CLIENT_INFO.timeout_behavior: Cadence +24h -> +48h -> +72h (configurable); max N attempts, then park to RECOVERY_LATER.
entry_requires: a non-document MissingItem blocks progress (dimensions, preferred time, budget, decision confirmation)
the specific blocking MissingItem(s) with weights w_i
allowed_ai_actions: send one targeted request via best channel
set a Promise ('client will send X')
prohibited_ai_actions: repeated pinging inside the AnnoyanceRisk cool-down
escalation_triggers: StuckScore high on a high-value case

WAITING_FOR_DOCUMENTS.timeout_behavior: Same cadence as WAITING_FOR_CLIENT_INFO (+24h -> +48h -> +72h, max N attempts -> RECOVERY_LATER). No explicit cap on needs_rescan re-request loops (see verification doc issue B).
entry_requires: a document/photo MissingItem blocks a quote or analysis (nameplate photo, VIN, floor plan, previous offer, invoice, contract, ID)
list of required document types + acceptance criteria (min resolution, which pages)
allowed_ai_actions: run a quality pre-check on arrival
prohibited_ai_actions: proceeding to analysis if the document quality check fails silently - must ask for a clearer scan (Evidence Confidence, 07-document-intelligence.md)
escalation_triggers: sensitive document types (notarial, legal) -> prepare for human review

DOCUMENT_ANALYSIS.timeout_behavior: Internal (no client wait) unless clearer docs needed. No explicit timeout or max-retry for repeated rescan cycles (see verification doc issue B).
entry_requires: at least one usable document/photo present that the case needs analyzed
documents with OCR text, extracted fields, Confidence
allowed_ai_actions: run Document Intelligence Worker: extract fields with evidence refs
prohibited_ai_actions: asserting facts below the confidence floor
DOCUMENT_ANALYSIS.followup_timing: internal (no client wait) unless clearer docs needed

QUOTE_PREPARATION.timeout_behavior: Internal; owner approval SLA tracked as a Task.
entry_requires: enough info + docs to draft a quote per the playbook's pricing rules
scope, quantities/dimensions
price rules or a human price input
MIS below the quote-blocking threshold
allowed_ai_actions: build a draft quote (base + premium variants)
request approval if pricing uncertainty is high (L2/L3)
prohibited_ai_actions: finalizing/sending a binding price without business rules coverage or human approval when uncertainty is high
QUOTE_PREPARATION.followup_timing: internal; owner approval SLA tracked as a Task

OFFER_SENT.timeout_behavior: No reply: +24h gentle check -> +72h value reminder -> +7d last-chance -> RECOVERY_LATER. Timing/channel by FollowUpPriority.
entry_requires: a quote/offer has been delivered to the client
Offer record with sent timestamp, channel, and content snapshot
allowed_ai_actions: watch for a competitor offer to compare

FOLLOW_UP_ACTIVE.timeout_behavior: Driven by FollowUpPriority; hard cap on frequency and count; on exhaustion, park to RECOVERY_LATER (or close per global closure edge).
entry_requires: any active case awaiting a client response (post-offer or post-info-request) where the completion loop drives cadence
FollowUpSequence with steps, channels, quiet hours, opt-out state
allowed_ai_actions: send the next best follow-up (channel + timing from FollowUpPriority)
prohibited_ai_actions: ignoring quiet hours or channel preference
FOLLOW_UP_ACTIVE.followup_timing: driven by FollowUpPriority; hard cap on frequency & count

NEGOTIATION.timeout_behavior: Tight cadence (hours to 1 day) while momentum is high; stalls route back to FOLLOW_UP_ACTIVE.
entry_requires: client is engaging on price/scope/terms or has produced a competitor offer
objection type(s)
competitor Offer (if any) with OfferScore
our authority bounds
allowed_ai_actions: prepare recommended responses within authorized discount/scope bounds
produce a DecisionBrief for the owner
prohibited_ai_actions: conceding warranty/legal terms without human sign-off
NEGOTIATION.followup_timing: tight cadence (hours to 1 day) while momentum is high

HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.timeout_behavior: Internal SLA reminders to the human (e.g. +2h, +1d); sla_breached flag on HumanApproval deadline miss. NO terminal timeout defined - infinite dwell possible (see verification doc issue A).
entry_requires: EscalationScore >= theta_escalate, or any hard rule (legal, high value, low confidence, emotion, unusual request)
a HumanApproval request with context, options, recommendation, evidence refs, and a deadline
prohibited_ai_actions: any state transition to a client-visible state without human decision
escalation_triggers: n/a (already escalated); may re-route to a different human/role
HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.followup_timing: internal SLA on the human (e.g. remind owner at +2h, +1d)

SCHEDULED.timeout_behavior: Reminder at -24h and -2h before the appointment; post-visit follow-up at +1d.
entry_requires: an appointment/visit/service date is booked (survey, install, service call)
calendar event, address, assigned technician/resource, confirmation
allowed_ai_actions: pre-collect anything needed before the visit

WON.timeout_behavior: Operational reminders only; no lifecycle timeout.
entry_requires: offer accepted / job booked-and-committed / contract signed (per playbook definition of 'won')
accepted Offer, value, agreed terms, next operational step

LOST.timeout_behavior: None immediately; recovery handled by RECOVERY_LATER.
entry_requires: client declined / chose a competitor / job cancelled
loss reason (required - captured for learning)
competitor if known
allowed_ai_actions: schedule RECOVERY_LATER if appropriate (seasonal, 'maybe next year')
prohibited_ai_actions: repeated re-pitching after a clear no
escalation_triggers: high-value loss (owner notification, not a block)

entry_requires: service delivered / job finished / final decision executed
completion confirmation; optional review/NPS request
allowed_ai_actions: schedule maintenance/renewal reminder as a NEW RECOVERY_LATER-linked case (spawn, never reopen)
prohibited_ai_actions: reopening the same case for new work (spawn a linked new case instead)
COMPLETED.followup_timing: n/a (terminal); may spawn a linked case

entry_requires: spam, wrong number, hard opt-out, or exhausted all contact attempts with no engagement
abandonment reason

RECOVERY_LATER.timeout_behavior: Single scheduled wake at wake_at (nightly sweep wakes due cases); re-evaluated by FollowUpPriority at wake; re-enters FOLLOW_UP_ACTIVE.
entry_requires: parked lead with future potential (silent lead, seasonal, lost-but-warm, won-with-upsell)
a wake_at timestamp and a recovery reason/trigger
allowed_ai_actions: none until wake_at; then re-enter FOLLOW_UP_ACTIVE with a fresh, context-aware opener
RECOVERY_LATER.followup_timing: single scheduled wake; re-evaluated by FollowUpPriority at wake

transitions.trigger: intent classified as a serviceable request (default path)
returning client asks to rebook a known job
transitions.guard: known party matched via Deal Memory
legal threat OR safety emergency OR abusive caller
LeadScore >= theta_qualify AND core required fields present AND fit-to-services C > 0
blocking MissingItem(s) identified with weights w_i
required document types + acceptance criteria listed

transitions.trigger: enough info + docs to draft a quote
transitions.guard: MIS below quote-blocking threshold; no blocking MissingItems skipped
playbook allows booking AND effective autonomy >= L4 (else HumanApproval)

transitions.trigger: requested info arrives (qualification criteria now met)
transitions.guard: LeadScore >= theta_qualify AND core fields present
max N follow-up attempts reached; wake_at set

transitions.trigger: hard opt-out or exhausted attempts with no recovery potential
StuckScore high on a high-value case

transitions.guard: max N follow-up attempts reached; wake_at set

transitions.trigger: hard opt-out or exhausted attempts with no recovery potential
repeated unreadable uploads or sensitive document types (notarial, legal)
analysis complete; case needs a quote
analyzed a competitor offer for a live deal

transitions.guard: DocRisk >= theta_docrisk OR legal/notarial content (hard override)

transitions.trigger: quote approved (human) or auto-sent per autonomy
transitions.guard: human approval OR (effective autonomy >= L4 AND inside price_rules AND < high_value_threshold AND Confidence >= theta_conf)

transitions.trigger: price outside rule bounds / margin below floor / unusual scope
client engages on price/scope/terms or produces a competitor offer
follow-up sequence exhausted, lead still warm
repeated objections / emotional signals / high-value stall
discount beyond bound / contract redlines / partner-legal approval needed
human decision routes the case (per 03 SS4: '* any active state')

transitions.guard: wake_at set with recovery reason (see verification doc issue D: reopening semantics ambiguous)
wake_at set; not a hard no / opt-out
abandonment reason captured; suppress all outbound

transitions.trigger: wake_at reached (nightly sweep wakes due cases)
transitions.guard: no opt-out; re-evaluated by FollowUpPriority; fresh context-aware opener

global_edges.name: escalation_interrupt
global_edges.notes: 03 SS2 invariant 5 / SS4. EscalationScore recomputed on every inbound event. Hard overrides (13 SS2.1): legal/notarial signing, safety emergency. MVP: hard-override rules only until S-ESC ships (Phase 3).

global_edges.name: closure_edge
global_edges.notes: 03 SS2 invariant 6 / SS4. Hard client opt-out (STOP / 'don't contact me') forces ABANDONED (or LOST if a reason is captured) and suppresses all future outbound actions permanently; also fires on follow-up exhaustion where recovery is inappropriate. Always legal; overrides the per-state transition table.

invariants.name: active_case_has_future_action
invariants.rule: An active case MUST have next_best_action != null AND next_action_due_at != null. The nightly stuck sweep fails loudly if an active case has no future action.

invariants.name: human_review_freezes_autonomy
invariants.rule: Any transition into HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED freezes all outbound autonomous actions; effective autonomy is capped at Level 2 'Prepare' (state_cap = 2 in the effective_level formula).

invariants.name: actor_authorized_or_queued
invariants.rule: A transition may only be executed by an actor allowed at the case's current autonomy level; otherwise the transition is queued as a HumanApproval.

invariants.name: every_transition_audited
invariants.rule: Every transition writes AuditEvent{from_state, to_state, actor, reason, evidence_refs} (immutable, hash-chained via hash_prev).

invariants.name: escalation_interrupt
invariants.rule: EscalationScore is recomputed on every inbound event; crossing theta_escalate forces a transition to HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED from any active state (global interrupt edge). MVP: hard-override rules only until the full EscalationScore model ships (Phase 3, task S-ESC).

invariants.name: hard_opt_out_closes_case
invariants.rule: A hard client opt-out (STOP / 'don't contact me') forces ABANDONED (or LOST if a reason is captured) and suppresses all future outbound actions permanently.

final_state_rule: No final state may transition without explicit human_override, except RECOVERY_LATER -> FOLLOW_UP_ACTIVE via the Completion Loop scheduled wake (scheduled_wake=true).
